title.official: Protocol to the Agreement Establishing the African Continental Free Trade Area on Digital Trade

issuer.name: Chairperson of the African Union Commission

relevance.reason: A continental digital-trade protocol whose objectives expressly include emerging and advanced technologies and which has an Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies. It is binding once in force, but it is not yet in force; the annex was not read in full, so its specific AI obligations are not asserted.
ai_provisions: Article 3 — specific objectives, including promotion of emerging and advanced technologies
Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies — listed in the compiled annexes; provisions not read in full
relevance.excluded_scope: Not in force. The Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies was not read in full; the record does not characterise its AI obligations beyond the subject matter.

dates.notes: Adopted by the AU Assembly on 18 February 2024. Eight annexes, including the Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies, were adopted by the 38th Ordinary Session of the Assembly in February 2025 (Assembly/AU/9(XXXVIII), para. 25; compiled annexes). Entry into force is governed by Article 47 of the Protocol and Article 23(2) of the AfCFTA Agreement (22 ratifications).

status_note: Adopted but not in force. The AU treaty page, accessed on 23 November 2026, lists the Protocol and the compiled annexes but displays no entry-into-force date and no ratification table for this Protocol. No depositary record was read, so the record does not assert a ratification count.
